collection.title: Porsche 911 Convertible 1998 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Porsche 911 Convertible 1998 to 2005 (996) requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
